summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of GigLine Safety & Compliance static marketing website. All core functionality working correctly with one minor issue.

integration_issues.issue: Formspree integration returns 404 error - placeholder endpoint 'xgvkbjze' not configured
integration_issues.impact: Contact form submissions fail, but error handling works correctly
integration_issues.workaround: Form shows appropriate error message directing users to email directly

passed_tests: Homepage loads correctly with hero section
Navigation works between all 4 pages (Home, Services, About, Contact)
Services page displays all 3 service offerings correctly
About page shows founder bio and credentials section
Contact page displays contact form and contact information
Mobile menu toggle works on mobile viewport
Contact form has all required fields with proper validation
All CTA buttons link to contact page correctly
Footer shows correct contact info and navigation links
LaunchPath external link opens correctly in new tab
Email and phone links properly formatted with mailto: and tel: protocols
Mobile responsiveness works across all pages
Desktop navigation hidden on mobile, mobile menu visible
action_item_for_main_agent: Replace Formspree placeholder endpoint 'xgvkbjze' in ContactForm.js with actual Formspree form ID to enable contact form submissions
